text:
anya: Quick follow-up from the Saturday outage postmortem — we sketched lots of actions but we need clear owners + dates. can each owner confirm? :eyes:

matt: I can take lead on the cloud-side mitigations (multi-region DNS failover + provider health gating). plan: prototype by next Tue, production rollout in 3 sprints. assigning myself: matt. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll own the model-registry side — token TTLs + retry/backoff and local metric exports. I'll push a draft runbook by end of week. assigning: sara.

tim: I'll handle auth-provider hardening (circuit breaker + cached creds + rotation monitoring). quick question: do we want a local fallback token store or a verification-only mode?

anya: good Q — prefer verification-only mode + short-lived fallback for critical paths. reduces blast radius.

lucy: ops can add provider health dashboards & alert thresholds. I'll create an alert runbook and add on-call playbook entries. target: next Wed. assigning: lucy.

matt: notes on cloud plan: we should add a capacity budget for cold region warmup, and a traffic-shift test window. sketch:
```
- add health gating: 3 consecutive failing probes -> avoid region
- DNS TTL: 30s for canaries, 300s for general traffic
- staged traffic-shift: 1%, 10%, 50% (30m holds)
```
I'll post the infra PR with scripts.

sara: model-registry plan snippet:
```
- short-lived download tokens (5m) + refresh endpoint
- local artifact cache w/ soft-ttl 10m
- instrument registry latency -> SLO 200ms
```
I'll share test harness next Monday.

tim: for auth provider:
```
- implement circuit breaker at SDK layer (fail open after 5s / 3 errors)
- fallback: verification-only token (no write perms) stored in KMS-wrapped blob
- daily smoke job to exercise fallback path
```
I can prototype this week.

anya: good. also we observed a recurring pattern: vendor auth blips + registry latency overlapped -> compounding failure. action item: add cross-service correlation alerts (SLO degradation + third-party error rates).

lucy: I'll wire a composite alert that fires when model-registry errors > 1% and auth errors > 0.5% for 10m. also will make a runbook step: "scale down non-critical jobs".

matt: question on timelines: what is our minimum viable mitigation (MVM) to deploy within 2 weeks? I think: provider health gating + registry soft-cache. that would drastically reduce live traffic dependency.

anya: agree — MVM = cloud gating (matt) + registry cache (sara) + basic circuit breaker (tim). owners: matt/sara/tim. Target milestone: 14 days from now. I'll block time on sprint planning to prioritize.

sara: noted. will carve out PR for cache + instrumentation this week.

tim: i'll submit SDK PR with circuit breaker config toggle for feature flagging.

deploy-bot: matt deployed infra/health-gating:staging at 2191234700 by matt — status: success. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks deploy-bot — nice! next steps: please update the postmortem action tracker with these owners + deadlines. I'll run a weekly 15m sync until all actions are closed. recurring calendar invite: "Dependency Mitigation Standup" — expecting attendees: matt, sara, tim, lucy.

lucy: added calendar invite for weekly check-ins.

matt: leaving a reminder here — I'll also add a short runbook snippet to the runbooks repo and tag @oncall when we flip each test.

anya: perfect. if anyone hits blockers ping me in this thread. closing for now, will reopen if blockers come up. :v:
